name: Fox, Firefoot Fennec
body:
These small, large-eared foxes possess a distinctive pattern of flame-colored fur around their paws, rather than the typical black “socks” of more common vulpines.

Firefoot Fennec

CR 1/4

XP 100
N Tiny animal
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 size)
hp 4 (1d8)
Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +1 (1d3-1)

STATISTICS

Str 9, Dex 17, Con 11, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Atk +0; CMB +1; CMD 10 (14 vs. trip)
Feats Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Acrobatics +3 (+11 jumping), Perception +8, Survival +1 (+5 scent tracking); Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics when jumping, +4 Survival when tracking by scent.

Source Wikipedia

ECOLOGY

Environment Temperate and cold forests and plains
Organization solitary, pair, pack (3-8)
Treasure none

Firefoot fennecs are regarded as good luck symbols, and by extension their uniquely colored pelts are prized by furriers.
